# BYD DiLink — Vehicle Signal Reference

Extracted from decompiled `DiCarServer.apk` (`com.byd.car.server`) and `CarSetting.apk` (`com.byd.carsettings`), merged 2026-07-28.

Every signal is a **vehicle property** addressed by a hex-string key, read/written through the `com.byd.car.property.ICarPropertyService` binder (service `autoservice` / `BYDAutoServer`):

```java
Response getProperty(String propertyKey)                 // e.g. "0x08000020"
Response getProperties(String[] propertyKeys)
Status   setProperties(CarPropertyValue[] values)        // for W signals
void     registerValueCallback(listener, String[] keys)  // live subscribe
```

**Total signals: 12184** across 54 categories.

### Provenance (`source` column)
- **both** (11253) — defined in DiCarServer *and* CarSetting dictionaries (agree).
- **dicarserver** (15) — only in the DiCarServer broker.
- **carsetting** (317) — **new**, only in the CarSetting app dictionary.
- **framework** (599) — only in the car's `framework.jar` (`android.hardware.bydauto.BYDAutoFeatureIds`), not in any app dictionary; added 2026-09-18 by `framework_signals.py`. Key is the value for protocol `CANFD`. These are reached through the `BYDAuto*Device` getters/setters — see `BYD_Framework_Methods.md`.
- **referenced_by_carsetting_ui = yes** (699) — the signal name actually appears in CarSetting UI code (outside the dictionary), i.e. surfaced on a settings/energy/health screen — the best pointer to where value interpretation lives.

> Note: one benign key conflict exists — `STATISTIC_TRACK_MODE_PERSONALIZED_MODE_CONFIGURATION_FLAG` is `0x46306042` in DiCarServer vs `0x4a306842` in CarSetting (app-version drift). The broker value (`0x46306042`) is kept as authoritative.

> Note: 4 signals were added 2026-09-18 after `validate_signals.py` found them missing — their keys use an uppercase `0X` prefix in source, which the original extraction skipped: `AC_REAR_PANEL_LOCK_HINT`, `RADIO_ENABLE_TA_TP_SET`, `RADIO_ENABLE_AF_SET`, `RADIO_PAUSE_TA_SET`.

> Note: 534 more app-dictionary signals were added 2026-09-18 (`validate_signals.py --add-missing`) — their names contain lowercase letters (e.g. `BODYWORK_ONLINE_HAS_0x02C500`, `ADAS_TORLevel_PRIORITY`, `SENSOR_AUTO_SLOPE_2nd`), which the original extraction skipped.

**Columns** — *Access*: `R` read/subscribe, `W` writable (`_SET`). *Type* inferred from name suffix (heuristic; wire value is dynamically typed). *source*: provenance above (*di* = dicarserver, *fw* = framework). *ui*: referenced by CarSetting UI.
